description: Hourly: the minimum of the next 12 forecast hours into input_number.climate_outdoor_min_12h, which the frost night targets read (docs/heating-energy-rating.md, frost setback). Fewer than 6 forecast hours, or a failed call, writes the measured outdoor temperature instead.
